title: Full projection repair takes over 40 minutes on a 1.16 GB store
outcome: Full projection repair takes over 40 minutes on a 1.16 GB store
acceptance: engram doctor --repair-projections on an export/import copy of the live Engram store (about 1.16 GB) completes in under 5 minutes on an idle host, with its existing rebuild-and-verify contract unchanged
The cause of the observed 2.5 TB of logical read transfer is identified and stated on this item
